_comment: Optional pre-authorization for desarrollar_web. Copy these entries into your ~/.claude/settings.json under permissions.allow. Covers build, images, and the Vercel draft-share capability. Scoped to this skill's own scripts, its Vercel MCP tools, and a few safe helpers — nothing destructive. The Vercel MCP connection itself must be added once, outside this file, with: claude mcp add --transport http vercel https://mcp.vercel.com
